[[AS Monaco FC|AS Monaco]] won '''Division 1 season 1987-88''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 52 points.

Promoted from [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], who will play in [[French soccer Division 1 1988/1989|Division 1 season 1988/1989]]
* [[RC Strasbourg]]:Champion of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group B
* [[FC Sochaux-Montbéliard]]:Runner-up, winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group A
* [[SM Caen]]:Third place, winner of barrages against [[Chamois Niortais]]
